Based on the visual analysis of the time series plot, there is a distinct and sudden shift in the level of the data (a step change or level shift) occurring around x = 510. Before this point, the values fluctuate roughly between -5 and 10. After this point, the values jump abruptly to a new range, fluctuating roughly between 20 and 25. This discontinuity represents an anomaly in the context of the previous trend.

The points involved in this sharp transition are approximately at x=510 and x=511.
